scope: Four-file implementation.patch against frozen baseline and candidate sources

scenario_reasons.1: Both retain two counters, stop unchanged rounds at two consecutive no-progress, allow supported different approach below four total, and require user authority after four.
scenario_reasons.2: Both preserve scope, targeted TDD, parent routing and latest handoff, reject redesign/child/queue authority, and block completion with failed checks. Baseline establishes intended-red classification as a prerequisite; candidate explicitly separates expected red from regression and invokes correction rules.
scenario_reasons.3: Both reuse adequate unchanged checks, require independent review, separate assignment/acceptance/capacity and host-confirmed release, and honor explicit commit prohibition.
scenario_reasons.4: Both continue authorized discussion without a mandatory stage/approval, keep unsupported performance unproven, reject unbudgeted benchmarks and saving including temporary files, and hand off conversationally without invented telemetry.
